market_demand: Driver-visible assist loss is the dominant public EPS pain category.
unmet_need: The pain is too broad; buyers need it converted into testable diagnostic/robustness scenarios.
eps_supplier_control: EPS supplier can define assist availability states, warning/DTC mapping, and diagnostic coverage expectations.
why_not_rca_8d: General loss-of-assist taxonomy is too broad for case-pack revenue.
next_validation: Use as top-level taxonomy for all other scenario families.
kill_condition: If it stays at complaint taxonomy without test/diagnostic actions.

market_demand: Low-speed assist loss creates high driver effort and has large-scale public history.
unmet_need: Need to know whether existing diagnostics explain assist demand vs delivered assist during low-speed high-effort events.
eps_supplier_control: EPS supplier can use HILS/bench/vehicle evaluation, assist command/current, speed, angle, current limit, thermal/voltage state.
why_not_rca_8d: Useful as a benchmark scenario; individual RCA packs remain case-specific.
next_validation: Create a coverage matrix: existing DTC/freeze frame vs low-speed high-effort facts.
kill_condition: If existing diagnostics already capture assist demand/output/current limit sufficiently.

market_demand: Public cases frequently connect EPS warning/MIL/DTC with increased effort.
unmet_need: Need to translate DTC/warning into driver symptom and quality explanation without adding generic logs.
eps_supplier_control: EPS supplier controls DTC semantics, freeze frame, occurrence counters, reader fields, and warning strategy.
why_not_rca_8d: 8D attachment is a downstream use; the scalable asset is DTC-to-symptom mapping coverage.
next_validation: Build a DTC-to-driver-pain matrix for public scenario families.
kill_condition: If current DTC docs already include symptom, context, and customer-quality wording.

market_demand: Intermittent assist loss that clears after restart appears across models and years.
unmet_need: Need to preserve transient/latch/reset context enough to explain recurrence and non-repro cases.
eps_supplier_control: EPS supplier controls ignition-cycle state, reset/fault latch, occurrence counter, and assist state transition.
why_not_rca_8d: It still needs program-specific state definitions; not a generic 8D product.
next_validation: Review whether existing extended data stores last ignition-cycle assist state and recurrence count.
kill_condition: If transient state is already captured or cannot be stored/read.

market_demand: Public investigation shows existing EPS DTCs already include voltage, temperature, friction-like modes.
unmet_need: Need to benchmark whether existing DTC/extended data is sufficient for market pain explanation.
eps_supplier_control: EPS supplier controls DTCs, derating, temperature, voltage, friction/load estimates.
why_not_rca_8d: This is strong evidence against new evidence packs; value is proving no gap or small gap.
next_validation: Audit a target EPS DTC list against voltage/thermal/friction public pain family.
kill_condition: Kill if this only repeats existing DTC documentation.

market_demand: No-warning or intermittent assist loss has high complaint and crash-allegation visibility.
unmet_need: Need to explain whether assist transition occurred before warning/DTC was available.
eps_supplier_control: EPS supplier may control assist enable edge and transition state, but storage/readout may be constrained.
why_not_rca_8d: Differentiation is higher, but data requirements are deeply internal.
next_validation: Identify the minimum transition facts that can be captured without waveform logging.
kill_condition: If no low-cost scalar transition facts exist.

market_demand: Rough road/pothole-triggered assist loss shows context-specific robustness pain.
unmet_need: Need to connect road event context to calibration/failsafe robustness.
eps_supplier_control: EPS supplier controls calibration and assist state, but road/IMU context may be OEM/vehicle-level.
why_not_rca_8d: Better as validation scenario than RCA/8D pack; needs vehicle context to scale.
next_validation: Test whether supplier bench/HILS can inject pothole/road shock proxy without OEM fleet data.
kill_condition: If road context cannot be represented with supplier-owned evaluation signals.

market_demand: Stop/start low-speed assist loss has high public scale and driver-visible pain.
unmet_need: Need to cover power transient, motor drive, and calibration behavior around stop-start/low-speed turns.
eps_supplier_control: EPS supplier controls motor drive, power/voltage state, calibration, and low-speed assist behavior in validation.
why_not_rca_8d: Scales better as robustness/diagnostic benchmark than case-specific 8D pack.
next_validation: Define stop-start low-speed EPS scenario and coverage checklist.
kill_condition: If target EPS has no stop-start transient exposure or existing validation already covers it completely.

market_demand: MDPS/ECU hardware, PCB, short/open issues appear in supplier/component-level public recalls.
unmet_need: Need to connect DTC, EOL, lot, return-part, and component evidence.
eps_supplier_control: EPS/ECU supplier controls EOL, traceability, DTC, returned-part reader, component quality records.
why_not_rca_8d: Closest to supplier-owned data, but not EPS market-wide; more quality/NRE than platform.
next_validation: Create hardware evidence chain template: DTC -> lot -> EOL -> return-part readout.
kill_condition: If existing manufacturing quality traceability already covers this with no gap.

market_demand: Turning noise/harness damage can cause reduced or complete assist.
unmet_need: Need to separate mechanical/harness physical issues from ECU-observed symptoms.
eps_supplier_control: EPS supplier can observe sensor/connector plausibility and assist current, but physical cause may be outside ECU.
why_not_rca_8d: Too cross-domain and case-specific for scalable RCA product.
next_validation: Use as boundary case for what EPS ECU can and cannot explain.
kill_condition: If mechanical team already owns the evidence flow.

market_demand: Software calibration can trigger failsafe and assist loss.
unmet_need: Need to ensure failsafe entry conditions, calibration version, and remedy mapping are explainable.
eps_supplier_control: EPS supplier controls software/calibration/failsafe logic, versioning, and validation evidence.
why_not_rca_8d: Scales as software readiness/coverage benchmark, not as 8D evidence service.
next_validation: Create calibration/failsafe evidence checklist reusable across programs.
kill_condition: If calibration release process already proves and exposes these facts adequately.

market_demand: Context-specific gradual-turn sticking and sudden assist return has distinct driver pain.
unmet_need: Need to capture steering-angle-zone and assist transition facts without full waveform logging.
eps_supplier_control: EPS supplier controls steering angle, assist state, torque/current response, and control-state transitions, but storage may be constrained.
why_not_rca_8d: Most differentiated from generic diagnostics, but very data/design-specific.
next_validation: Define scalar facts for gradual-turn sticking: angle zone, transition edge, assist delta, recurrence.
kill_condition: If it requires high-rate waveform logging or OEM-only data.

market_demand: Worm gear/mechanical issues can cause sudden loss of assist.
unmet_need: Need to know what ECU can infer about mechanical load/friction and what must stay mechanical inspection.
eps_supplier_control: EPS supplier may estimate load/friction but physical confirmation is mechanical.
why_not_rca_8d: Too gear-specific unless paired with gear maker/program NRE.
next_validation: Test whether existing friction/load estimate is meaningful for this family.
kill_condition: If ECU estimate is not trusted for mechanical root cause separation.
